scripts.build: pnpm --filter api build && pnpm --filter web build
scripts.lint: pnpm --filter api lint && pnpm --filter web lint
scripts.verify: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm test && pnpm test:e2e && pnpm db:validate && pnpm build
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter api exec prisma migrate dev
